verdict.rationale: Remote markets itself as a global payroll platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent payroll features: syncing payroll inputs and data via API, downloading payslips, and contractor invoice approval. Nothing documents an end-to-end payroll run flow covering review of hours and earnings, a totals preview, and submission.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow
